name: Greymane Wall
summary: The Greymane Wall is a massive stone bulwark spanning the southern frontier of Silverpine Forest. Built by King Genn Greymane after the Second War, it seals the kingdom of Gilneas away from the outside world behind impenetrable, locked gates.

sections.title: A Monument to Isolation
sections.body: Following the Second War, King Genn Greymane grew resentful of the Alliance of Lordaeron, particularly the taxes required to maintain the orc internment camps. Deciding Gilneas had given enough of its coin and blood for foreign troubles, Greymane withdrew from the Alliance and ordered a colossal barrier raised across the head of the peninsula. When the Third War brought the Plague of Undeath and countless desperate refugees to its foot, the gates remained pitilessly barred.

sections.title: The Price of Seclusion
sections.body: While the rampart kept the armies of the Scourge from overrunning the peninsula, the lands outside it found no such safety. In Silverpine, the archmage Arugal of Dalaran summoned feral worgen to fight the undead, but the beasts proved uncontrollable and now prowl the forest beneath the silent wall. What passes behind its gates remains unknown to the outside world.

faq.q: What lies beyond the Greymane Wall?
aliases: what kingdom is behind the wall
faq.answer: Behind the wall lies the peninsula kingdom of Gilneas. Ruled by King Genn Greymane, it completely isolated itself from Lordaeron and the rest of the world before the Third War, barring all commerce and communication.

faq.q: Can you open the gates of the Greymane Wall?
aliases: how to get past greymane wall
faq.answer: No. The massive portcullis and iron-banded doors are firmly barred from the southern side. Gilneas has severed all contact with the outside world, and nothing enters or leaves.

faq.q: Why was the wall built here instead of farther south?
aliases: why did they build it here
faq.answer: The reasons for its exact course are not recorded. The wall spans the southern edge of Silverpine Forest at the head of the Gilnean peninsula, leaving villages such as Pyrewood and Ambermill on its northern side.

faq.q: What happened to the refugees who fled here during the Third War?
faq.answer: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, masses of fleeing human refugees gathered outside the wall begging for entry. King Greymane refused to unseal the gates to protect his kingdom, and the desperate refugees were eventually slaughtered by the undead outside.

angles.text: The Greymane Wall stands as a bitter reminder of Gilnean abandonment. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, Greymane turned a deaf ear to his former allies, leaving them to rot outside his gates.
For the Forsaken who now claim Silverpine Forest, the wall forms an impassable southern border, sealing away a human kingdom whose intentions and inner strength remain entirely unknown.
